title: Evaluation under coordinate pullback
statement: Let $m,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $e:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be an injection, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ and $U\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ satisfy $i\in S$ if and only if $e(i)\in U$ for every $i$. For a decision tree $T$ on the $n$-coordinate cube with available set $U$, and every input $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^m$, evaluating the tree pulled back along $e$ at $x$ equals evaluating $T$ on the $n$-coordinate input that takes value $x_i$ at $e(i)$ and $0$ at every coordinate outside the image of $e$.
